index.title: index
index.content:
This wiki is a work in progress. It provides additional information to the upcoming book Warukaru by Cebe Osani, which can be found on Royal Road and Scribble Hub.
Disclaimer
While no AI was used in writing the book itself, Claude AI was used to summarize sections for some wiki articles and images were generated with the CottonAnima model. Maps were created using Azgaar’s Fantasy Map Generator.
